clue.text: Stake attached to the Spanish climbing plant

parts.note: to stake money on something is to bet it
el is the Spanish word for 'the'

explanation.surface: A gardener ties a Spanish vine to a supporting stake.
explanation.definitionFit: Betel is an Asian vine whose leaves are chewed with areca nut, a climbing plant.

clue.text: Walk a little way — then go by bus?

parts.note: ST, short for street, is a little way in the sense of a road abbreviated
to ride is to travel as a passenger, as on a bus

explanation.surface: Someone walks a short distance and then catches a bus for the rest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a little way' is a small road abbreviated: ST, the short form of street.
explanation.definitionFit: A stride is a long step, and to stride is to walk purposefully.

clue.text: The magnificence of new garden city

indicators.note: new signals that the letters of garden are made into something fresh, rearranged

parts.note: Ur is the ancient Mesopotamian city, the crossword's standard city

explanation.surface: Admiring the splendour of a freshly built garden city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges GARDEN into GRANDE; Ur is the ancient city of Abraham, a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: Grandeur is splendour or impressiveness, a synonym of magnificence.

clue.text: It's mean to keep a girl in such a long time

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: an age is a very long time
Vera is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Someone complains it is unkind to keep a girl waiting so long.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mean' passes for unkind in the surface but is the statistical sense; 'It's' and 'in such' are only joining words.
explanation.definitionFit: In statistics the mean is the arithmetic average of a set of values.

clue.text: Pinch your old-fashioned secret

parts.note: to pinch is slang for to steal
thy is the archaic form of your

explanation.surface: Someone is told to filch an old secret of theirs.
explanation.walkthrough: Pinch is British slang for stealing; thy is the old form of your, as in the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Stealthy means done covertly, so secret describes a stealthy movement.

clue.text: Children not working well

parts.note: a machine that is off is not working
a spring is a natural source of water, like a well

explanation.surface: Unemployed children who are nonetheless in good health.
explanation.walkthrough: 'well' looks like an adverb or 'healthy', but it is a water source: SPRING.
explanation.definitionFit: Offspring are a person's descendants, their sons and daughters.

clue.text: First run comes from straight stroke in cricket match

parts.note: a Test is an international cricket match
a straight drive is a cricket shot hit back past the bowler

explanation.surface: A batsman's straight shot in a cricket match yields the first run.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a Test is a full international match and a drive is an attacking shot; the pieces go in answer order, match first.
explanation.definitionFit: A trial outing in a car before buying it is its first run on the road.

clue.text: Inflexibly formal

explanation.definitionFit: Stiff describes something that will not bend and, of manner, stilted or unrelaxed.

clue.text: Reflection of one's own outspoken views

definitions.text: Reflection of one's own outspoken views

parts.words: Reflection of one's own outspoken views
parts.note: a sound bounced back repeats what was spoken aloud, and someone who repeats your opinions does the same

explanation.surface: Hearing your own forthright opinions repeated back by another.
explanation.definitionFit: A reverberation is sound reflected back, and a person who parrots your views is said to do the same.

clue.text: Inventor resigned in a tantrum

indicators.note: a tantrum throws things about, so the letters of resigned are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: An inventor quits his post in a fit of temper.
explanation.definitionFit: A designer devises new products or plans, so is a creator or inventor.

clue.text: I am in pursuit in a carriage

indicators.note: the speaker says they are inside, so the letter for I sits within the next piece

parts.note: a chase is a pursuit

explanation.surface: Someone declares they are giving chase while riding in a carriage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'am in' puts I inside CHASE; the second 'in a' is a joining phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A chaise is a light horse-drawn vehicle, a type of carriage.

clue.text: Yield what is sown, say

indicators.note: say signals the word is spoken, so its sound gives the answer

parts.note: seed is what a farmer sows

explanation.surface: A farmer wonders how much crop his sowing will produce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yield' tempts as crop output, but it means give up.
explanation.definitionFit: To cede territory is to surrender or give it up.

clue.text: A favour likely to gain applause?

definitions.meaning: a kind deed done to help someone
a fine act on stage, which an audience would clap

explanation.definitionFit: A kindly deed is a good turn; a turn is also a stage act, and a good one earns clapping.

clue.text: Soldier mixing general a drink

parts.note: GI is the term for an American soldier

indicators.note: mixing stirs up the letters of general into a new order

explanation.surface: A soldier mixes a drink for his commanding general.
explanation.definitionFit: Ginger ale is a fizzy soft drink flavoured with ginger, often used as a mixer.

clue.text: It provides an opening for parachutists

definitions.text: It provides an opening for parachutists

parts.words: It provides an opening for parachutists
parts.note: not a doorway in the plane but the cord pulled to open the canopy

explanation.surface: Something that offers a way out to skydivers.
explanation.definitionFit: The ripcord is pulled to deploy the parachute, opening the canopy.

clue.text: One in charge of a spinning wheel

definitions.text: One in charge of a spinning wheel

parts.words: One in charge of a spinning wheel
parts.note: not a spinner of yarn but the casino attendant running the roulette wheel

explanation.surface: A cottage spinner tending her spinning wheel.
explanation.definitionFit: A croupier runs a gaming table in a casino, including the roulette wheel.

clue.text: Postponing one's leave

parts.note: putting off one's departure means remaining where one is

explanation.surface: Someone delays taking their holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay a judgement is to defer it, and remaining put defers one's departure.

clue.text: Two trials setting a precedent

definitions.note: a descriptive phrase for a noun: a legal action whose outcome sets a precedent

parts.note: a test is a trial, and so is a court case
a test is a trial, and so is a court case

explanation.surface: Two court hearings that establish a legal precedent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Two trials' gives both pieces: a trial as a test, and a trial as a lawsuit.
explanation.definitionFit: A test case is a lawsuit whose verdict establishes a principle for later rulings.

clue.text: Student starts singing choral composition

indicators.note: the start of singing means just its opening letter
a composition puts things together in a new arrangement, so choral is rearranged

explanation.surface: A music student begins singing a choral piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A scholar is a learner or someone studying, a student.

clue.text: Not knowing what to believe and acting so strangely

indicators.note: strangely signals that the letters of acting so behave oddly and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A confused person behaves oddly, unsure of what to believe.
explanation.definitionFit: An agnostic holds that God's existence is unknowable, so is undecided about belief.

clue.text: Carry small child with ease at first

parts.note: a tot is a small child

indicators.note: at first means just the opening letter of ease

explanation.surface: A parent lifts a toddler with no trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: To tote is to lug or haul something along.

clue.text: Team making use of spin

definitions.meaning: in billiards and snooker, spin put on the ball by striking it off-centre

explanation.surface: A team relying on spin bowling.
explanation.definitionFit: A playing XI is a side, and in British snooker side is also the swerve given to a struck ball.

clue.text: What the public wants to ask?

definitions.meaning: to require or call for firmly

explanation.definitionFit: Market appetite for goods is demand, and to demand something is to request it insistently.

clue.text: Note the arrangements of sails in vessels

parts.note: B is a musical note
a rig is the way a ship's masts and sails are set up

explanation.surface: A sailor notes the rigging set up on ships.
explanation.definitionFit: A brig is a two-masted square-rigged sailing ship.

clue.text: Under treatment, impart personal depression

indicators.note: something under treatment is being worked on, so the letters of impart are reworked

explanation.surface: Someone in therapy shares their private sorrow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Under treatment' rearranges IMPART. 'depression' suggests low mood but means a hollow in the body.
explanation.definitionFit: The hollow beneath the shoulder joint is a depression in one's own body.

clue.text: Again, but for the last time presumably

definitions.meaning: a single additional time, implying no more after it

explanation.definitionFit: Doing something one further time is a repeat, and saying it just one more time suggests it is final.

clue.text: Large marble passage

definitions.meaning: a big playing marble, often made of alabaster

explanation.definitionFit: An alley is both a large marble in children's games and a narrow backstreet.

clue.text: Young servant conceals crime at the manse

indicators.note: to conceal is to hide inside, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: a page is a boy servant
arson, setting fire to property, is a crime

explanation.surface: A page boy hides evidence of a crime at the minister's house.
explanation.walkthrough: A manse is a Scottish minister's house; 'at the' simply joins the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A manse is a minister's house, as is a parsonage, the home provided for a parish clergyman.
